reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "The default value of `hubble.tls.auto.certValidityDuration` has been lowered from 1095 days to 365 days because recent versions of MacOS will fail to validate…", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Hubble TLS certificates will have a shorter validity duration (365 days instead of 1095 days), preventing validation failures on recent macOS versions that reject certificates with expirations longer than 825 days.

proposed.statement: The default value of Helm value hubble.tls.auto.certValidityDuration has been lowered from 1095 days to 365 days to prevent certificate validation failures on recent versions of macOS.
